interface.longDescription: slopie — search your past coding-agent sessions. It keeps every Claude Code, Codex and pi session on this machine as a plain-text record (~/.slopie/records) and gives Codex one skill, slopie, to search them with its shell or `slopie search`. Plus `slopie audit`, a Wrapped of your year. Local only: no models, no daemon, no network.
